problem: Inadequate urban sanitation systems in Indian cities, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas and peripheries, requiring decentralized (non-networked) sanitation solutions.
solution: Structured engagement program (SCBP) with academic institutions to integrate non-networked sanitation into curricula, research, and training through Round Table meetings, faculty training workshops, and MOUs with universities.
outcome: By March 2019, 9 universities had signed MOUs with SCBP; the conclave at CEPT University facilitated collaborative problem-solving on urban sanitation challenges through a sandpit activity and distributed certificates.
